---
title: "Classify an Animal"
format: html
---

<input id="photo" type="file">
<button id="btn">Classify Image</button>
<div id="results"></div>

<script type="module">
    import { Client } from 'https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@gradio/client/dist/index.min.js';
    async function classifyImage(file)
    {
        const client = await Client.connect("siyalizo/animal_classification")
        const res = await client.predict("/classify_images", {
            image: file
        })
        results.innerHTML = `<br><img src="${URL.createObjectURL(file)}" width="300px"><p>${res.data[0]['label']}</p>`;
    }
    function read()
    {
        const file = photo.files[0]
        if (!file)
        {
            alert("Please select a file first.")
            return
        }
        classifyImage(file)
    }
    btn.addEventListener('click', read)
</script>
